phase.quote: This paper describes the design and construction of the MicroBooNE liquid argon time projection chamber and associated systems.

target_medium.quote: MicroBooNE liquid argon time projection chamber

summary.plain: A 170-tonne tank of liquid argon on the Booster neutrino beam at Fermilab that photographs neutrino collisions in three dimensions with wires instead of film. It was built to check a puzzling excess of events seen by an earlier experiment.
summary.technical: Single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber with 170 t total argon mass and 90 t inside the TPC, 2.56 x 2.325 x 10.368 m active volume, 2.6 m maximum drift, 8256 wires on three planes, 470 m from the BNB target.

technology.quote: MicroBooNE is a large 170-ton liquid-argon time projection chamber (LArTPC) neutrino experiment
technology.value: single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber
